title: Senior Civil Engineer
jobDescription:
About us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

The Role

As a Senior Civil Engineer with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

Purpose: As a Senior Civil & Structural Engineer, you will be responsible for leading and some time originating, checking and guiding others the Civil Engineering discipline on feasibility studies, FEED, detailed engineering, EPC, and brownfield projects. You will provide technical leadership, ensure quality and timely delivery of civil engineering deliverables, and support project execution across multidisciplinary teams.
You will act as the focal point for all civil engineering activities, interface with clients, coordinate with other disciplines, and mentor a team of civil engineers and designers.

Technical Leadership

  • Civil engineering design and execution for industrial facilities including Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Energy, Power, and Infrastructure projects.
  • Develop and review civil design philosophies, specifications, reports, and calculations.
  • Lead site development and grading design.
  • Design and review:
    • Roads and pavements
    • Drainage systems
    • Stormwater management systems
    • Underground utilities
    • Earthworks and grading
    • Retaining structures
    • Blast-resistant and industrial facilities
  • Analysis and design of:
    • Pipe racks
    • Equipment support structures
    • Technological structures
    • Warehouses and industrial buildings
    • Process structures
    • Conveyor systems
    • Cooling towers
    • Water tanks
    • Modular structures
    • Existing facility modifications and brownfield projects
  • Review geotechnical reports and establish design criteria.
  • Coordinate with geotechnical consultants and external stakeholders.
  • Develop civil material take-offs and quantity estimates.
  • Lead equipment foundation design under static and dynamic loads.
  • Direct seismic and wind engineering studies.

Project Management & Coordination

  • Plan discipline activities and monitor schedule adherence.
  • Interface with Project Managers and Engineering Managers.
  • Manage scope, deliverables, budgets, and resource requirements.
  • Coordinate with Structural, Mechanical, Piping, Electrical, Instrumentation, and Process disciplines.
  • Participate in client meetings and technical reviews.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor engineers and designers.
  • Perform technical reviews and ensure compliance with company procedures.
  • Support competency development and training initiatives.
  • Promote innovation and continuous improvement.

Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with applicable international codes and standards.
  • Participate in HAZID, HAZOP, Constructability, and Risk Assessment studies.
  • Ensure engineering deliverables comply with project quality requirements.
  • Champion safety-in-design principles and OH&S requirements.

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

Experience

  • 12–20 years of experience in Civil Engineering design for industrial projects.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Experience in FEED and Detail Engineering projects.
  • Exposure to international projects and clients is preferred.


Technical Skills

  • Site development and grading design.
  • Drainage and utility network design.
  • Foundation loading and interface coordination.
  • Familiarity with:
    • ACI
    • BS Codes
    • Eurocodes
    • IS Codes
    • ASCE Standards
    • UFC Standards
  • Working knowledge of:
    • Civil 3D
    • Auto CAD
    • Micro Station
    • GIS platforms

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Civil/Structural Engineering.
  • Master's Degree in Structural Engineering preferred.
  • Chartered Engineer / Professional Engineer registration desirable.

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Safety Engineer Level I
jobDescription:
About us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

The Role

As a Safety Engineer Level I with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

  • Supports adherence to generally accepted engineering and design practices, regulatory requirements, and customer specifications.
  • Supports the standardization of equipment specifications, drawings, and document templates.
  • Contributes to the understanding of technical knowledge, legal requirements, and customer specifications whenever viable and lawful.
  • Uses local/global standards to support technical excellence.
  • Supports the processes for checking, peer reviews, and incorporation of comments and findings.
  • Ensure recognised onshore & offshore engineering practices applicable to safety & risk design are adopted.
  • Development of design and operational engineering studies in the areas of risk, safety and Safety & Risk.
  • Designs Safety & Risk scope of work in contract and stewards design alternative studies, as required, to optimize project cost and schedule.
  • Gathering and compiling safety and environmental information.
  • Prepares and assists in the execution of: Hazard Studies (HAZID- ENVID/HAZOP/LOPA); HSE Checklist and Design Basis; Design HSE Review such as Human Factors, Hazardous Area Classification, Inherent Safety, Alarm Prioritisation.

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

Industry Specific Experience:

  • Have engineering experience in Brown Field oil and gas related Safety & Risk Design and Engineering.
  • Must have 5+ years experience in the same or similar industry, including experience in multi-disciplinary projects and teams.
  • Experience in the Middle East, is an advantage.
  • Working as a Safety and Risk Engineer (Technical Safety / Loss Prevention) in the Oil and Gas Industry.
  • Must have experience in offshore projects.

Education – Qualifications, Accreditation, Training:

  • Full-Time Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical Engineering/mechanical Engineering from an accredited university.
  • Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng)/CFPS status or undertaking the same will be an advantage.

IT SKILLS:

  • PIPENET, PHAST, SAFETI, PHA Pro, Flaresim, Detect3D (optional), ex SILentia (optional).

Key areas of expertise required:

  • Active Fire Protection (Firewater demand, hydraulic analysis, P&IDs, PFDs, etc).
  • F&G layouts, C/E diagrams.
  • Passive Fire Protection.
  • Datasheets and specifications, MTO.
  • Hazardous Area Classification (Schedule and Drawings).
  • Good knowledge of NFPA and International Standards for Technical Safety / Loss Prevention.
  • Consequence analysis (gas dispersion, toxic, fires, explosion, vent dispersion, flare radiation modeling).
  • Safety Critical Elements and Performance Standards.
  • Risk Register / action follow-up and close-out.
  • ALARP assessment, Bow-ties, and Cost-Benefit analysis.

Moving forward together

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Manager II, Quality
jobDescription:
About us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

Purpose of the Role: Participates in the development and implementation of global Quality programs and initiatives. Conducts Quality audits and surveillance activities across global processes and project delivery operations to ensure compliance with the Worley Management System and ISO 9001 requirements.

The Role

As a Manager II, Quality with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

  • Quality Audits/Assessments
    • Conduct Quality audits/assessments and surveillance activities to evaluate the conformity and effectiveness of project delivery and non-project processes against Worley standards and requirements.
    • Prepare Audit/assessment and surveillance reports, communicate findings and recommendations to relevant stakeholders.
    • Verify the effectiveness of corrective actions and monitor their timely implementation and closure.
    • Develop risk-based assessment and surveillance plans, checklists, and questionnaires.
    • Support the planning and coordination of ISO 9001 surveillance and recertification audits and ensure effective closure of corrective. actions.
  • Quality Assurance
    • Work closely with global quality teams to support development of Quality Assurance planning.
    • Facilitate Root causes analysis- RCA- for project and non-project related Quality events and non-conformances.
    • Coordinate the development of Quality learning modules and materials.
    • Co-lead/participate in the periodic Quality awareness activities at global level such as Quality weeks, Quality campaigns…etc
    • Provide advice/ information on Quality Assurance matters.
  • Quality improvement initiatives
    • Participate in global and regional Quality improvement initiatives.
    • Contribute to the maintenance and improvement of Quality processes and procedures.
    • Support the development, implementation and monitoring of Quality KPIs.
    • Contribute to Worley’s strategic Quality initiatives across people, processes and systems, digital enablement, data and analytics, and Quality culture.
  • Reporting & Dashboards
    • Prepare periodical Quality Reports highlighting key trends, performance against targets, root cause insights, and recommended actions.
    • Facilitate discussions to drive understanding of quality performance and improvement actions.

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

  • Essential experience /skills/qualifications / training
    • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Business, or related discipline.
    • +10 years’ experience in project Quality management. Industry Exposure - Engineering, Procurement or Construction Management (EPCM environment).
    • Experience in Auditing (IRCA ISO 9001 Lead auditor).
    • Good understanding of ISO 9001: Quality Management System.
    • Problem solving and root cause analysis (RCA) tools
    • Quality measurement and performance data analysis.
    • Risk Management knowledge and good understanding of Quality risk-based approach.

    • Excellent coordination, communication, Analytical thinking, stakeholder engagement skills.

title: Quality Digital Systems and AI Enablement
jobDescription:
About us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

Purpose of the Role

Ensures the implementation and continuous improvement of Quality systems, dashboards, and digital tools, including the integration of AI and machine learning into Quality processes to drive efficiency, enhance insights, and support informed decision‑making for business leaders. Additionally, champions artificial intelligence across the Quality function through initiatives such as the development of Quality-focused AI agents and the delivery of AI capability-building and training across the Quality community of practice.

The Role

As an Quality Digital Systems and AI Enablement with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

  • Digital and AI road map
    • Work closely with the Quality Leadership Team to support and contribute to the digital and AI roadmap of the Quality function, ensuring alignment with Worley’s digital strategy.
    • Act as the focal point for advising on digital solutions and AI initiatives that enhance Quality capabilities.
    • Provide support to global digital initiatives to enable the integration of Quality-related data into global digital platforms and standard delivery software, testing and validation of AI assist tools related to MS/KS System.
    • Contribute to improving data structures to enable AI-driven insights and predictive quality analytics.
  • Quality digital systems and tools
    • Administer Quality digital systems, tools, and dashboards, including user access, role management, and configuration support.
    • Act as first-line support for Quality digital system issues, data queries, and reporting discrepancies, escalating when required.
    • Support Quality digital system enhancements, upgrades, and releases in coordination with system owners and Digital/IT teams.
    • Work closely with Worley Assurance System team to coordinate the improvements to enhance the quality of data and reporting.
    • Maintain and enhance standard Quality dashboards, scorecards, and routine reports.
    • Develop and deliver AI enablement, automation, and simplification of Quality processes and reporting (e.g., automated workflows, intelligent data validation, insights generation).
    • Identify opportunities for digitization and continuous improvement of Quality systems and processes.
  • Quality working groups and networks
    • Promote adoption of digital tools and AI-enabled ways of working across the Quality community. Train and assist Quality team on new developed digital and AI tools and agents.
    • Maintain and continuously improve AI-retrievable knowledge repositories within collaboration platforms (Share Point, Teams, Viva Engage), including content structuring, tagging, and access management.
  • KPIs
    • Timely delivery of Quality reports, dashboards, and audit data.
    • Improved data quality, consistency, and governance across Quality systems.
    • Reduction in manual effort through automation and digital enhancements.
    • Stakeholder satisfaction with accessibility, accuracy, and usability of Quality insights.
    • Structured, user-friendly, and AI-optimized collaboration and knowledge spaces.
    • Adoption of AI-enabled tools and process improvements within the Quality function.
  • Key internal interfaces
    • Quality practitioners and auditors.
    • Digital Operations and Security.
    • Digital Transformation / AI teams.
    • Project and operational teams.

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

  • Essential qualifications/ training / attributes
    • University degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent experience.
    • Strong understanding of digital tools, and data governance.
    • Highly familiar with AI agents (e.g Copilot).
    • Strong knowledge in digital tools such as Power BI, Power Apps, Share Point…etc
    • Understanding of data pipelines and analytics, Python, APIs, integrations.
    • Familiarity with Worley Assurance System.
    • Ability to support users, troubleshoot issues, and improve system usability.
    • Pragmatic, structured, and process-oriented mindset.
    • High attention to detail with a strong focus on data integrity.
  • Desirable experience
    • Exposure to AI, automation tools, or digital workflow platforms for process optimization.
    • Working knowledge of data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, or similar).
    • Experience supporting or developing dashboards, analytics, or reporting for Quality, audit, or operational teams.
    • Familiarity with Worley Quality processes (or equivalent organizational frameworks).

Moving forward together

description:
About us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

Purpose of the Role

Ensures the implementation and continuous improvement of Quality systems, dashboards, and digital tools, including the integration of AI and machine learning into Quality processes to drive efficiency, enhance insights, and support informed decision‑making for business leaders. Additionally, champions artificial intelligence across the Quality function through initiatives such as the development of Quality-focused AI agents and the delivery of AI capability-building and training across the Quality community of practice.

The Role

As an Quality Digital Systems and AI Enablement with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

  • Digital and AI road map
    • Work closely with the Quality Leadership Team to support and contribute to the digital and AI roadmap of the Quality function, ensuring alignment with Worley’s digital strategy.
    • Act as the focal point for advising on digital solutions and AI initiatives that enhance Quality capabilities.
    • Provide support to global digital initiatives to enable the integration of Quality-related data into global digital platforms and standard delivery software, testing and validation of AI assist tools related to MS/KS System.
    • Contribute to improving data structures to enable AI-driven insights and predictive quality analytics.
  • Quality digital systems and tools
    • Administer Quality digital systems, tools, and dashboards, including user access, role management, and configuration support.
    • Act as first-line support for Quality digital system issues, data queries, and reporting discrepancies, escalating when required.
    • Support Quality digital system enhancements, upgrades, and releases in coordination with system owners and Digital/IT teams.
    • Work closely with Worley Assurance System team to coordinate the improvements to enhance the quality of data and reporting.
    • Maintain and enhance standard Quality dashboards, scorecards, and routine reports.
    • Develop and deliver AI enablement, automation, and simplification of Quality processes and reporting (e.g., automated workflows, intelligent data validation, insights generation).
    • Identify opportunities for digitization and continuous improvement of Quality systems and processes.
  • Quality working groups and networks
    • Promote adoption of digital tools and AI-enabled ways of working across the Quality community. Train and assist Quality team on new developed digital and AI tools and agents.
    • Maintain and continuously improve AI-retrievable knowledge repositories within collaboration platforms (Share Point, Teams, Viva Engage), including content structuring, tagging, and access management.
  • KPIs
    • Timely delivery of Quality reports, dashboards, and audit data.
    • Improved data quality, consistency, and governance across Quality systems.
    • Reduction in manual effort through automation and digital enhancements.
    • Stakeholder satisfaction with accessibility, accuracy, and usability of Quality insights.
    • Structured, user-friendly, and AI-optimized collaboration and knowledge spaces.
    • Adoption of AI-enabled tools and process improvements within the Quality function.
  • Key internal interfaces
    • Quality practitioners and auditors.
    • Digital Operations and Security.
    • Digital Transformation / AI teams.
    • Project and operational teams.

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

  • Essential qualifications/ training / attributes
    • University degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent experience.
    • Strong understanding of digital tools, and data governance.
    • Highly familiar with AI agents (e.g Copilot).
    • Strong knowledge in digital tools such as Power BI, Power Apps, Share Point…etc
    • Understanding of data pipelines and analytics, Python, APIs, integrations.
    • Familiarity with Worley Assurance System.
    • Ability to support users, troubleshoot issues, and improve system usability.
    • Pragmatic, structured, and process-oriented mindset.
    • High attention to detail with a strong focus on data integrity.
  • Desirable experience
    • Exposure to AI, automation tools, or digital workflow platforms for process optimization.
    • Working knowledge of data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, or similar).
    • Experience supporting or developing dashboards, analytics, or reporting for Quality, audit, or operational teams.
    • Familiarity with Worley Quality processes (or equivalent organizational frameworks).

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Structural Engineer Level I
jobDescription:
• We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
  • Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.
  • Enjoy a varied & challenging role.


Building on our past. Ready for the future

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.

Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.

We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.

  • Key Responsibilities
    • Perform structural analysis and design of Fixed Jacket Structures, Lifted Topsides, and Float‑Over Topsides, covering in‑service, pre‑service, and accidental load cases.
    • Should be able to Develop structural models from scratch, and prepare engineering calculations, reports.
    • Should be able to review the drawings from engineering prespective.
    • Deliver structural engineering work packages within defined scope, budget, and schedule requirements.
    • Coordinate design input with internal disciplines and drafting teams to ensure timely and quality deliverables.
    • Assist in developing design philosophies, analysis methodologies.
    • Participate in technical discussions, interdisciplinary reviews, and model review sessions.
    • Support preparation of RFQs and review vendor documents for steel plates, hot‑rolled sections, tubulars, LMUs, grout seals, anodes, and related items.

    • Contribute to knowledge sharing and promote best practices within the engineering team.

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil/Structural Engineering.
  • 4 to 7 years of relevant experience in offshore structural engineering.
  • Experience in analysis and design of Fixed Template Structures, FPSO modules, and offshore renewable structures (wind, hydrogen, CCS).
  • Good exposure to FEED/EPC project environments.
  • Familiarity with steel material grades, testing requirements, and fabrication specifications.
  • Technical Skills
    • Familiarity with Fatigue analysis, non-linear analysis and FEA analysis.
    • Good understanding of weight control principles for offshore structures.
    • Familiarity with international design codes including ISO 19901, ISO 19902, AISC, API (WSD & LRFD), DNV.
    • Hands‑on experience with tools such as SACS, SESAM, USFOS, ANSYS, ABAQUS, STAAD.
    • Experience with Python/VBA automation.
  • Soft Skills
    • Strong communication skills for coordination with internal teams and external stakeholders.
    • Ability to work independently under supervision of senior engineers with sound engineering judgment.
    • Proactive attitude toward learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.

We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.

Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

Worley takes personal data protection seriously and respects EU and local data protection laws. You can read our full Recruitment Privacy Notice Here.

Please note: If you are being represented by a recruitment agency you will not be considered, to be considered you will need to apply directly to Worley.

title: Facilities Supervisor II
jobDescription:
About us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

Role Purpose

As a Facilities Supervisor with Worley, you will have to manage the end-to-end office / workspace operations for Worley’s Hyderabad office – including provision of excellent workspace experience for our employees through provision of excellent Facilities services. Implement robust corporate governance i.e. compliance to relevant statutory guidelines and company policies, adherence to budgetary and cost control guidelines, etc. Be the SPOC for all key internal and external stakeholders i.e. employees, company leadership, service providers, statutory bodies, etc. Adopt a holistic approach to excellent workspace environment which nurtures people safety, productivity and employee delight.

Key Responsibilities

A. Workspace Management

  • Ensure workplace safety compliance (Assurance Portal, JHA, Emergency Response Plans)
  • Drive space management including planning, allocation, and optimization
  • Manage asset lifecycle (procurement, tracking, audits, disposal)

  • Oversee workspace maintenance (housekeeping, engineering services, preventive maintenance)

  • Implement and monitor workspace security (access control, surveillance systems, guards)
  • Govern facility management service providers and ensure SLA adherence

Support Workspace Infrastructure Projects

  • Execute workspace infrastructure projects (office setup, expansion, refurbishment)
  • Ensure delivery within timelines, budget, and quality standards
  • Optimize utilization of real estate and infrastructure investments

Employee Services

  • Manage corporate travel operations and vendor relationships
  • Oversee employee transportation (bus services logistics and efficiency)
  • Plan and execute corporate events
  • Manage canteen and refreshment services (tea/coffee)
  • Oversee printing, stationery, and mailroom operations
  • Coordinate IT asset logistics and distribution
  • Manage employee company car services

Corporate Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure adherence to company policies and SOPs
  • Maintain compliance with statutory laws (workspace & manpower regulations)
  • Ensure vendor service contracts meet all contractual obligations
  • Drive digitalization and automation of admin processes
  • Support audits and ensure audit readiness

Budgetary & Cost Control

  • Prepare and manage annual budgets
  • Control costs through invoice verification, processing, and approvals
  • Track and report financials including quarterly NDCs
  • Identify and implement cost optimization initiatives

Team & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead and develop team capabilities
  • Demonstrate service mindset, respect, and assertive communication
  • Manage internal stakeholders (employees, leadership, business units)
  • Build strong partnerships with external vendors and service providers

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • SLA adherence (%)
  • Budget vs. actuals variance (%)
  • Cost savings achieved
  • Workplace safety metrics (incidents, audit scores)
  • Employee satisfaction (admin services)
  • Project delivery (time, cost, quality)
  • Compliance audit outcomes

Qualifications & Experience

  • Graduate in any discipline (MBA preferred)
  • 10–12 years of experience in Facility Management /
  • Experience managing large offices, vendors, and budgets

Key Skills

  • Facility management & vendor management
  • Workspace / office infra project management
  • Budgeting & cost control
  • Stakeholders management
  • Compliance & governance
  • Strong (assertive) communication & leadership

Behavioral Competencies

  • Respectful and assertive communication
  • Excellent team player
  • Service mindset & result oriented

· Solutions driven approach

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

description:
• We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
  • Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.
  • Enjoy a varied & challenging role.


Building on our past. Ready for the future

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.

Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.

We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.


The Role

As a Senior Business Analyst with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

  • Comfortable working across both functional and technical aspects (from Design perspective) in complex environments to gather & interpret business & functional requirements.
  • Have conducted workshops, done gap analysis (as-is vs. to-be analysis) & designed effective solutions aligning with Service Now best practices.
  • Campion in creating business requirement documents (BRD), process design document, drafting use cases, user stories etc.
  • Having design mindset, used tools like Figma in past, should possess basic understanding of Widget, pages, themes, UI components in Service Now using HTML, CSS, Java Script to create best wireframes.
  • Apply UI/UX best practices to improve usability, accessibility, and performance across Service Now functions within Worley.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve UI issues and defects.
  • Ensure consistency with brand standards and design systems across all Service Now interfaces.
  • Good understanding on UI/UX concepts to design any catalogs/user forms/surveys.
  • Own digital content, AI-enabled self-service initiatives, Service Catalog, ITSM, process improvements on the Service Now platform to ensure accuracy, relevance, and quality.
  • Good understanding and implementation of Service Now employee portal , taxonomy , topic mappings across various functions.

Other Attributes

  • Have functionally designed the Service Catalog and Service Portal using dynamic request forms, Service Catalog Variables, Approval Process, RITM Lifecycle Management, SLA, Notification.
  • Have a basic understanding of Integration method using REST/SOAP/Flow designer/UI builder while working with ITSM and Service Catalog.
  • Drive user experience with latest Service Now platform capabilities like Omni channel, NOW Mobile, Virtual Agent, process optimization, etc.
  • Comfortable working with global stakeholders across different regions.

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

  • Minimum qualification: Bachelor Degree in IT / Computers.
  • Excellent communication skills, Collaborative, solution-oriented mindset with 8-12 Years of relevant experience in Service Now.
  • Experienced working across both functional and technical aspects (from Design perspective) in complex environments to gather & interpret business & functional requirements.
  • Service Now CSA Preferred and ITIL certification Mandatory.


Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.

We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.

Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

Worley takes personal data protection seriously and respects EU and local data protection laws. You can read our full Recruitment Privacy Notice Here.

Please note: If you are being represented by a recruitment agency you will not be considered, to be considered you will need to apply directly to Worley.

title: EDS Specialist- AE\AIM
jobDescription:
• We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
  • Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.
  • Enjoy a varied & challenging role.

Building on our past. Ready for the future

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.

Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.

We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.

The Role

  • As an EDS Specialist- AE\AIMwith Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
  • Understanding, documenting and managing the functional requirements (business scope) for an AVEVA Engineering implementation.
  • Performing AE support tasks.
  • Performing project implementations including configurations, reports and gateways.
  • Suggesting how to improve AE or optimize implementations.
  • Providing advanced support and troubleshooting.
  • Promote use of AE and the value it brings to the projects within the organization.
  • Continually seeking opportunities to increase end-user satisfaction.
  • The Asset Information Management Administrator is responsible for project set up, maintenance and support of the system.
  • Require significant SQL skills as well as the ability to work as part of a team to deliver integrated solutions. All aspects of data integration complex systems that include design and engineering systems, data management as well as extraction and validation of legacy data.

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Diploma in Engineering with at least 5 years experience.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience of AVEVA Engineering.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience of AVEVA AIM.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience of AEVA PDMS/E3D Administration.
  • In-depth working knowledge of configuration and management of AVEVA Engineering including project Administration.
  • Fully proficient with management of Dabacon databases.
  • Knowledge of Engineering workflow in an EPC environment.

title: Senior Project Control Specialist
jobDescription:
Building on our past. Ready for the future

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.

As a Senior Project Control Specialist with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

  • Lead and guide the Project Controls team for Schedule and Cost function on the Project.
  • Work with Project leadership team in alignment and strategic discussions on the project.
  • Develop and finalise the Project Controls Plan as per Project requirements and interface with Client and internal stakeholders.
  • Lead and develop the Progress measurement system for the project based on the contractual reporting requirements and processes.
  • Actively participate in Schedule development and guide the team to the required Planning and scheduling requirements.
  • Conduct / lead Schedule workshops, IAP sessions and focus discussions on Schedule baselining and forecast exercises as required.
  • Review, Tracking & monitoring Schedule & Critical areas through LEM and Scrums, raising the flag for the delays & areas of concerns.
  • Establish WBS and CBS required for the project as per the reporting requirements in line with the Client discussions.
  • Interact with Project and department stakeholders in functional discussions and support required in delivering the Projects assigned.
  • Preparation and analysis of Project performance statistics and analytics as appropriate.
  • Lead to set up Project Cost reports, internal monitoring metrics and other reporting requirements.
  • Monitoring & controlling the cost by various analysis and time to time information Management about the risk areas.
  • Performing Risk Analysis on the Schedule and provide inputs / recommendations.
  • Generating various reports like Progress S-curves, Lookahead Plan, Variance Analysis, Productivity Analysis.
  • Invoicing, preparing Cash flow and presenting in the APEX monthly level meeting.
  • Daily/Weekly/Monthly reports
  • Attend Internal and Client review meetings as required to present the Project performance, Concerns, and recovery plans etc.
  • Work closely with the Project and Engineering managers to ensure proactive approach on addressing project performance and recovery measures all times.
  • Mentor and guide junior team members and impart knowledge transfer time to time.
  • Participate internal innovative forums and contribute for the Digital growth in project delivery wherever possible.
  • Preparation of project cost reports and provide forecast analysis and trends of the project.
  • Liaise effectively with multidisciplinary teams, fostering collaborative relationships, and ensuring alignment between planning, execution, and project objectives.

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

  • Tertiary qualifications in Graduate in Engineering/Technology.
  • 12+ years of experience in Working for similar type Projects/Industry experience.
  • Proven leadership and communication skills
  • Extensive experience in Oil & Gas, energy sector & Chemicals.
  • Sound knowledge of Planning, Cost control and Monitoring.
  • A dedication to client satisfaction
  • Excellent relationship building and stakeholder management skills.
  • You will be an enthusiastic team player, with excellent stakeholder management skills.
  • Proactive thinking and solution-oriented delivery.

title: Piping Engineer Level I
jobDescription:

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. description:
• We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
  • Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.
  • Enjoy a varied & challenging role.


Building on our past. Ready for the future

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.

Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.

We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.


The Role

As a HSE Specialist I with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

  • Responsible for overseeing the HSE compliance of Contractors in a mega project.
  • Strong understanding and exposure in driving Contractor HSE management system.
  • Thorough understanding of HSE statutory requirements specific to India.
  • Convene meetings with internal stakeholders to set the HSE expectations.
  • Conducting Monthly HSE auditing to review the Contractor HSE compliance.
  • Investigating the incidents reported to capture the learnings.
  • Preparing and reviewing the risk assessment process.
  • Conducting safety campaigns to create awareness among the work force.
  • Reviewing the effectiveness of Emergency mock drills by conducting periodic mock drills.
  • Liaising with Customer & Contractor to align with company HSE expectations.

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

  • B.E./ B.Tech / B.Sc. (Physics / Chemistry / Maths) / Diploma in engineering from recognized Institute and Diploma in Industrial Safety from recognized university. Examination of such course should have been conducted by Technical Education Board of respective state or approved university.
  • Must have more than 10 years of experience for BE/ B. Tech and 13 years for BSc./ Diploma Engineers, in managing HSE activities in construction industries.


Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.

We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.

Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

Worley takes personal data protection seriously and respects EU and local data protection laws. You can read our full Recruitment Privacy Notice Here.

Please note: If you are being represented by a recruitment agency you will not be considered, to be considered you will need to apply directly to Worley.

title: Piping Designer Level II
jobDescription:
About us
Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

The Role

As a Piping Designer Level II with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc

  • Accountable for producing and maintaining piping deliverables including, but not limited to:
    • Drawings, designing experience with PDMS, E3D, SP3D models will be preferred in accordance with oil & gas industry.
  • Produce the various discipline deliverables to the agreed schedule.
  • Standards, codes and client specifications within the schedule and budget as set-out by the Lead Piping Designer. The position must support in the overall delivery.
  • Apply good interpersonal skills, liaising with members of other disciplines and departments.
  • Create and respond to technical queries.
  • Carry out 3D modelling & design activities of piping systems & supports.
  • Draught & check detailed design drawings of piping systems & supports in accordance with industry standards, codes and client specifications.
  • Prepare & check materials take-offs and bill of materials.
  • Provide technical input during detailed engineering of projects.
  • Provide support and input into the preparation of PED technical files.

Other Attributes

  • Provide support and input into the preparation of construction work packs and certification documentation.
  • Responsible for technical decision-making associated with any given scope of work.
  • Establish good working relationships and communication with discipline leads, department managers and clients.
  • Undertake any other general duties that may be requested the list of duties is not exhaustive in any way and may change at any time.

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

  • A Certificate or Diploma in Piping Design / Drafting, with a preference for a Piping Engineering Degree.
  • Minimum 13-18 years of experience in the design and drafting of offshore and onshore oil and gas facilities and associated sub-structures.
  • Experience with PDMS/E3D/S3D design software packages.


Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobDescription:
About us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

The Role

As a Senior Electrical Engineer with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

  • Electrical system design for the assigned project interacting with other disciplines, client and vendors as required.
  • Monitor own progress and ensure it comes within project schedule
  • Conduct site visit and data gathering.
  • Preparation of load list and equipment list.
  • Preparation of calculations for electrical systems such as voltage drop, equipment sizing, lighting, earthing and cable sizing etc.
  • Preparation power system study reports and relay coordination using software.
  • Preparation of electrical power distribution concepts, SLD, schematic diagrams etc.
  • Preparation of cable schedules and interconnection schedules.
  • Preparation design basis.
  • Preparation of specifications and data sheets.

Additional RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Preparation of material requisition (Requisition For Quotation).
  • Preparation of technical bid evaluation reports.
  • Review equipment vendor data.
  • Give input to Drafting personnel for preparation of drawings.
  • Checking of drawings including interface with related drawings of own discipline and other discipline
  • Maintenance of design file and relevant data etc.
  • Assistance to Lead Engineer.
  • Adherence to the committed schedule.
  • Control of electrical design budget and schedule.
  • Technical supervision of electrical designers and draftsmen.
  • Preparation of manhour estimates to perform project tasks based on tender scope documents and scope change.
  • Adherence to Quality Assurance system, applicable procedures, Design basis, Applicable design guides / Standards / Specifications as applicable.

  • Safety – Responsible for personal safety safe working practices for the CSG, etc. Understand and follow OH&S procedures.

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

  • Degree in Electrical engineering (B.E. or B. Tech).
  • 6 years + plus design experience within the hydrocarbons.
  • Familiarity with national and international standards such as IS, IEC, BS, OISD, IE Rules.
  • Experience in use of electrical system software such as EDSA, ETAP.
  • Very well conversant with Load flow studies, Short circuit studies, Motor starting studies, Relay coordination, Arc flash studies, Harmonics studies, Earthing studies etc. in ETAP.
  • Experience in PSCAD will be added advantage.

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.

We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.

Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Manager, Payroll Process Optimization
jobDescription:
• We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
  • Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.
  • Enjoy a varied & challenging role.

Building on our past. Ready for the future

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.

Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.

We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.

The Role

As a Manager, Payroll with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

Worley Finance is in the midst of an exciting transformation, reimagining payroll delivery and building a revitalised, future ready capability within our WES shared service centre. This new role will sit at the centre of that shift, strengthening payroll integrity and shaping a trusted, solutions focused partnership with stakeholders.

The Payroll (& Time) Operations Enablement Manager is accountable for protecting payroll delivery by owning upstream processes, integrations, data quality, and downstream reporting. This role ensures payroll operations are enabled by accurate inputs, effective controls, and high quality operational insights. The role will report to the Senior Director Payroll Experience and Delivery.

Key Accountabilities

  • Upstream Payroll & Time Enablement
    • Own and oversee upstream processes feeding payroll, including employee data, time & attendance, and related integrations.
    • Ensure data integrity, completeness, and readiness prior to payroll processing.
    • Act as the primary safeguard protecting payroll from upstream errors.
  • Operational Controls & Assurance
    • Execute key pre payroll controls, validations, and exception management.
    • Monitor and resolve timekeeping errors, roster issues, and system defects.
    • Maintain strong audit trails and evidence supporting payroll accuracy.
  • Reporting & Insights
    • Deliver centralised payroll and time reporting to Finance, People, and the business.
    • Provide operational insights on trends, errors, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
    • Support performance dashboards, KPIs, and management reporting.
  • Stakeholder Support
    • Support managers and employees with payroll and time system issues.
    • Coordinate resolution of systemic issues impacting payroll and time experience.
  • Continuous Improvement
    • Identify upstream process improvements to reduce payroll and time risk and manual intervention.
    • Support automation and simplification of time and payroll enablement activities.

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

  • Experience & Capability
  • Strong payroll and/or time & attendance operational experience.
  • Deep understanding of payroll inputs, integrations, and data dependencies.
  • Control minded, detail oriented, and process driven.
  • Strong stakeholder coordination and problem solving capability.

Requirements of Role

  • Ability to travel domestically
  • Hybrid Role

experienceProfile.rawText: We deliver the world's most complex projects. Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team. Enjoy a varied & challenging role. Building on our past. Ready for the future Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. Right now, we're bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects. The Role As a Manager, Payroll with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc. Worley Finance is in the midst of an exciting transformation, reimagining payroll delivery and building a revitalised, future ready capability within our WES shared service centre. This new role will sit at the centre of that shift, strengthening payroll integrity and shaping a trusted, solutions focused partnership with stakeholders. The Payroll (& Time) Operations Enablement Manager is accountable for protecting payroll delivery by owning upstream processes, integrations, data quality, and downstream reporting. This role ensures payroll operations are enabled by accurate inputs, effective controls, and high quality operational insights. The role will report to the Senior Director Payroll Experience and Delivery. Key Accountabilities Upstream Payroll & Time Enablement Own and oversee upstream processes feeding payroll, including employee data, time & attendance, and related integrations. Ensure data integrity, completeness, and readiness prior to payroll processing. Act as the primary safeguard protecting payroll from upstream errors. Operational Controls & Assurance Execute key pre payroll controls, validations, and exception management. Monitor and resolve timekeeping errors, roster issues, and system defects. Maintain strong audit trails and evidence supporting payroll accuracy. Reporting & Insights Deliver centralised payroll and time reporting to Finance, People, and the business. Provide operational insights on trends, errors, root causes, and improvement opportunities. Support performance dashboards, KPIs, and management reporting. Stakeholder Support Support managers and employees with payroll and time system issues. Coordinate resolution of systemic issues impacting payroll and time experience. Continuous Improvement Identify upstream process improvements to reduce payroll and time risk and manual intervention. Support automation and simplification of time and payroll enablement activities. description:
• We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
  • Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.
  • Enjoy a varied & challenging role.

Building on our past. Ready for the future

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.

Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.

We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.

The Role

As a Manager, Payroll with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

Worley Finance is in the midst of an exciting transformation, reimagining payroll delivery and building a revitalised, future ready capability within our WES shared service centre. This new role will sit at the centre of that shift, strengthening payroll integrity and shaping a trusted, solutions focused partnership with stakeholders.

The Payroll (& Time) Operations Enablement Manager is accountable for protecting payroll delivery by owning upstream processes, integrations, data quality, and downstream reporting. This role ensures payroll operations are enabled by accurate inputs, effective controls, and high quality operational insights. The role will report to the Senior Director Payroll Experience and Delivery.

Key Accountabilities

  • Upstream Payroll & Time Enablement
    • Own and oversee upstream processes feeding payroll, including employee data, time & attendance, and related integrations.
    • Ensure data integrity, completeness, and readiness prior to payroll processing.
    • Act as the primary safeguard protecting payroll from upstream errors.
  • Operational Controls & Assurance
    • Execute key pre payroll controls, validations, and exception management.
    • Monitor and resolve timekeeping errors, roster issues, and system defects.
    • Maintain strong audit trails and evidence supporting payroll accuracy.
  • Reporting & Insights
    • Deliver centralised payroll and time reporting to Finance, People, and the business.
    • Provide operational insights on trends, errors, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
    • Support performance dashboards, KPIs, and management reporting.
  • Stakeholder Support
    • Support managers and employees with payroll and time system issues.
    • Coordinate resolution of systemic issues impacting payroll and time experience.
  • Continuous Improvement
    • Identify upstream process improvements to reduce payroll and time risk and manual intervention.
    • Support automation and simplification of time and payroll enablement activities.

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

  • Experience & Capability
  • Strong payroll and/or time & attendance operational experience.
  • Deep understanding of payroll inputs, integrations, and data dependencies.
  • Control minded, detail oriented, and process driven.
  • Strong stakeholder coordination and problem solving capability.

Requirements of Role

  • Ability to travel domestically
  • Hybrid Role

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.

We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.

Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

Worley takes personal data protection seriously and respects EU and local data protection laws. You can read our full Recruitment Privacy Notice Here.

Please note: If you are being represented by a recruitment agency you will not be considered, to be considered you will need to apply directly to Worley.

title: Accountant II
jobDescription:
• We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
  • Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.
  • Enjoy a varied & challenging role.

Building on our past. Ready for the future

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.

Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.

We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.


The Role

As a Senior Accountant with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc

  • Oversight and control of General Ledger (GL) activities to ensure financial accuracy, compliance, and alignment with business objectives. Proven expertise in driving process optimization and enhancing operational efficiency.
  • Month-end closing – GL closure:
    • Analysis of monthly costs (direct & indirect), corporate and local allocations including a comparison of budget vs actual. This includes review of facilities, software usage, function costs, labor G&A etc.
    • Post necessary accrual / provision / reclass entries in GBS / FCC after management approvals.
    • Present variance analysis to the finance management and operations, explain reasons for change and actions required.
    • Review reversal of previous month entries and ensure all necessary entries relating to AP, GL, treasury, payroll, prepaid amortization, depreciation etc. are accounted before GL closure.
  • Month-end reporting –
    • Post GL closure, generate trail balance, verify for completeness and accuracy and upload into FCC.
    • Post the entries in FCC & planning which were not posted in GBS or wrongly posted in GBS (Burden release, accruals, entries on hold, IC mismatch etc.)
    • Prepare and upload balance sheet schedules in FCC with commentary.
    • Participate in month end P&L (LRP) reviews with operations and provide explanations on key changes and responses to the queries directed.
  • Financial Planning and forecasting –
    • Participate in annual financial planning process, provide inputs on direct and indirect costs (including labor G&A), APR and burden rates, facilities, software, local and corporate allocations etc. Present an analysis and commentary to local management on the key changes from last year.
    • Participate in quarterly rolling forecasts and provide inputs and insight on headcount, costs, and allocations along with a comparison with annual plan and actual till date and assumptions for remainder of the year.
  • Property, Plant and Equipment and Leases accounting –
    • Monthly accounting of PPE and leases as per the relevant Ind AS or IFRS.
    • To ensure additions, deletions, depreciation are accurately accounted in the system monthly.
    • Capitalization of assets on a month-on-month basis.
    • Preparation of Fixed Asset register monthly along with variance analysis for major movements.
    • Preparation of Blackline schedules, HFM schedules pertaining to PPE and leases.
    • Actioning on asset disposals basis request received from user department as per expected timelines.
    • Completion of physical verification of PPE as per the coverage as decided by the management before the start of statutory audit process.
  • Trust accounting and compliance –
    • Ensure timely and accurate accounting, finalization, and audit of social security trust of Worley (Gratuity, PF, SF etc.)
    • Ensure monthly/ Quarterly/ yearly compliance of regulations governing the social security trust.
    • Ensure constant monitoring of trusts’ investments, work with the investment advisors, keep an eye on market developments and take timely actions on investing, redeeming, exiting as necessary.
  • Audits–
    • Lead Management and Statutory Audit activities for the Worley entity (knowledge of Ind AS/ IFRS mandatory). Be the focal point of contact for the auditors from audit planning to signing of audit report.
    • Facilitate preparation of audit schedules, RCMs and management assessment; coordinate with other members of operational finance and facilitate submission of audit deliverables.
    • Respond to auditors’ queries and coordinate responses from other stakeholders within operational finance.
  • Other activities –
    • Advance tax calculations – Prepare statement of estimated tax liability every quarter, considering the YTD actual results, forecast for the remainder of the year, exemptions, and changes to previous assumptions etc. Present the calculations to tax manager and operational finance leader for review and approval.
    • Blackline reconciliations - Prepare/Review/Approve all Balance Sheet accounts reconciliation in blackline as per assigned area of responsibility. Note actions from reconciliation review & take necessary actions in the current month.
    • Work towards automation of manual / mundane tasks, work with IT / process / FP&A team on designing / implementing dashboards for key cost items (e.g. labor G&A, facilities, software usage etc.)
    • Evaluate and validate vendor financial submissions for upcoming projects.
    • Any other ad-hoc tasks that are assigned by the local management.

About You
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

  • EDUCATION: Chartered Accountant.
  • Experience: 6 - 10 years in similar profile. Experience of audit in Big 4s would be preferred
  • IT and other Skills:
    • Good working knowledge in MS Office Applications (specially excel and word).
    • Experience of Accounting Software – Oracle, would be preferred.
    • Good communication, presentation, and inter-personal skills.
    • Ability to contribute individually and work seamlessly with a group / team.
    • Attention to details, inclination to deep dive, analyze, rationalize and act proactively

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.

We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.

Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

Worley takes personal data protection seriously and respects EU and local data protection laws. You can read our full Recruitment Privacy Notice Here.

Please note: If you are being represented by a recruitment agency you will not be considered, to be considered you will need to apply directly to Worley.
